title: Earnings Expected Move: Options-Implied Moves Input

symbols.title: Tickers (optional)
symbols.description: Only these tickers. Their next earnings date within 45 days is looked up. Leave empty to scan the calendar instead.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: Calendar window when no tickers are given: today plus this many days.

minMarketCapUsd.title: Min market cap (USD)
minMarketCapUsd.description: Calendar mode: skip companies smaller than this. 10,000,000,000 = $10B.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies
maxCompanies.description: Cap on companies priced (largest first). Controls cost.
